title: Build shared CAD/BIM application shell (Web + Electron)
objective: Deliver the first production implementation work item for the CAD/BIM application: the shared application shell that proves the frozen Architecture v1.1 CAD/BIM client topology (ACR-002, §5.3). The shell implements the shared renderer/editor core, the Web Host and Electron Host, the CAD/BIM App API (semantic command/query contract v1), the CADDocument model (versioned working representation, §5.4), and the adapter boundary with a dummy engine/file adapter as the boundary test double. The implementation follows the Issue #24 build order: Shared Renderer -> Web Host -> Electron Host -> CAD/BIM App API -> CADDocument -> Adapter Boundary. The first PR must prove Web/Electron parity, document serialization/versioning, transport independence, dummy-adapter operation, undo/redo, CI reproducibility, and the absence of engine-specific coupling (LOCK-018). This work item does NOT integrate production CAD/BIM engines (FreeCAD/OCCT/IfcOpenShell) — those are a future work item behind the proven adapter boundary — and does NOT alter Architecture v1.1 (FROZEN).
acceptance_criteria: Web and Electron hosts prove parity: the same semantic command/query sequence through the Web Host and the Electron Host yields identical CADDocument content (LOCK-017, §5.5).

Document serialization/versioning: canonical JSON round-trip preserves identity; the version chain satisfies data-model.md §2 (entity_id, version_id, version_number, parent_version_id, created_at, created_by, source_snapshot_id, status) and is reconstructable via parent_version_id (LOCK-005).

Transport independence: the renderer talks to hosts ONLY through the Transport contract; the wire command/query contract is versioned (v1) and survives a JSON serialization boundary losslessly (§5.5, api-contract.md §1/§8).

Dummy-adapter operation: an end-to-end open -> applyEdit -> serialize -> undo -> redo -> verify workflow runs entirely against the in-memory dummy EngineAdapterBundle, with no FreeCAD/OCCT/IfcOpenShell import anywhere in the dependency graph (LOCK-003/018).

Undo/redo: the CADDocument model implements command-log + inverse semantics for addElement, removeElement, updateElement and setProps; undo reverts content and version, redo restores the child version; a new execute after undo clears the redo stack (§5.4, §15).

CI reproducibility: the deterministic test suite and canonical-serialization hashes are reproducible; two fresh handler instances given the same command sequence produce identical content hashes (LOCK-004/005).

No engine-specific coupling: a static check asserts that no source file under src/contracts, src/renderer, src/app-api or src/caddocument imports Electron, browser UI, FreeCAD, OpenCascade or IfcOpenShell (LOCK-018, §5.5).
non_goals: No production CAD/BIM engine integration (FreeCAD/OCCT/IfcOpenShell) — a future work item behind the proven adapter boundary; this work item proves the boundary with the dummy adapter only.
No Construction Graph integration — CADDocument is the editor's working representation, not the canonical project/asset system of record (LOCK-019, §5.4); Graph mapping is a separate work item.
No legal/composition approval — that is LICENSE-001's decision; RESEARCH-CAD-006 feeds it and continues separately.
No production packaging change — out of scope per Issue #24; the Electron runtime bootstrap (require('electron')) is deferred to a packaging work item.
No architecture change — Architecture v1.1 remains FROZEN; no protected path is touched.
risk_assumptions: REAL-ENGINE INTEGRATION DEFERRED: CAD-IMPLEMENT-001 proves the adapter boundary with the in-memory dummy adapter (src/adapters/dummy). Production engines (FreeCAD/OCCT/IfcOpenShell) are a future work item behind the EngineAdapterBundle contract and are NOT imported by this work item; the dummy adapter carries the ADAPTER_BOUNDARY_MARK and satisfies the same interface (LOCK-003: a replacement engine must not require renderer or CADDocument redesign).

CAD-006 CONTINUES SEPARATELY: RESEARCH-CAD-006 (exact-version licensing/composition evidence) is not a hard dependency of CAD-IMPLEMENT-001; this work item builds against the frozen Architecture v1.1, not against CAD-006's research output. CAD-007 (the final CAD/BIM feasibility gate: adapter boundary, replacement path, existential end-to-end workflow) remains untouched until CAD-006 is VERIFIED, per the execution directive.

ELECTRON BOOTSTRAP DEFERRED: the host layer + Transport contract are proven by test/host-parity.test.ts (same sequence through WebHost+WebSocketTransport and ElectronHost+IpcTransport yields identical content). The actual require('electron') main-process bootstrap (BrowserWindow loading the renderer bundle, native IPC channel wiring) is deferred to a packaging work item; src/host-electron/main.ts documents the integration point and is intentionally not wired to the Electron runtime so the host layer remains testable without it installed.

CONSTRUCTION GRAPH DEFERRED: CADDocument identity is editor/file identity, not Construction Graph identity (LOCK-019, §5.4). The mapping from CADDocument model versions to Construction Graph entities through explicit versioned contracts/events is a separate work item; CAD-IMPLEMENT-001 does not claim Graph authority.

SPEC DIVERGENCE: spec/work-items.md defines PLATFORM-006 ('Unified application shell', dependencies PLATFORM-002/COMPAT-SHEET-001/COMPAT-DOC-001/COMPAT-CAD-001/COMPAT-PM-001) as the closest frozen ancestor of this work item. CAD-IMPLEMENT-001 is defined by Issue #24 as a new production-implementation track (CAD-IMPLEMENT-*) scoped to the CAD/BIM shell specifically; the implementer follows Issue #24 and flags the divergence (same superseded-wording pattern as RESEARCH-CAD-001..006, where the GitHub Issue redefines the work item).

WIRE BINARY FORM: the command/query contract is JSON (api-contract.md); binary file sources travel as a JSON array of numbers (number[]), not as a Uint8Array, because Uint8Array is not JSON-native. The App API handler normalizes number[] -> Uint8Array for the file adapter; a production transport may use binary frames, but the contract semantics are unchanged.
Architecture version: this record targets v1.1 (active, FROZEN) per the execution directive ('Architecture v1.1 remains frozen').

Dependency gate: this work item depends on ARCH-WF-001 (VERIFIED — the governance foundation, state machine and validator). The real-engine work item (future) will additionally depend on the VERIFIED CAD research gates; CAD-IMPLEMENT-001 does not, because it does not exercise the engines.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated test suite proving all seven acceptance criteria above, reproducible from the committed source with no network access.
Canonical serialization + version-chain + undo/redo evidence bound to the implementation revision.
Web/Electron parity evidence (same sequence -> identical content hash) bound to the implementation revision.
Dummy-adapter end-to-end evidence (open -> edit -> serialize -> undo -> redo -> verify) with no engine imports.
Forbidden-import static check evidence (LOCK-018) bound to the implementation revision.
CI workflow reproducing the local evidence on a different execution environment (ubuntu-latest).
No claim of VERIFIED; the implementer produces evidence and submits for Architect review (LOCK-004: implementation status is not evidence).

evidence.description: CI workflow fix + green run on ddaca31 (milestone-3 final, this turn). Both packages (root + app/) declare engines '>=20' so Node 22 is permitted; apps/web/ has no engines constraint.
